dataList.content:
<Were those Abnormalities responsible for killing all the employees?>
<就是刚刚那个异想体杀死了所有员工吗？>
dataList.place:
District 4 - LC Branch Interior
4区 脑叶公司支部内某处

dataList.title:
Grade 8 Fixer
8阶收尾人
dataList.content:
I doubt that. If my guess is right...
不对。如果我没猜错的话……

Please keep your eyes forward, Executive Manager. There’s another one of them.
请注意前方，经理。那里还有个和刚才一样的家伙。

A humanoid being wearing the head of a statue was slumped against the wall.
走廊尽头有个戴着石像头套的东西，正虚弱地靠在墙边。

dataList.title:
A Survivor?
幸存者？
dataList.content:
Hi...? Are you... here to... draw your lot...?
嗨……？你们也是……来抽签……的吗……

dataList.title:
A Survivor?
幸存者？
dataList.content:
Gather all your IDs... and give them... to me... Then we’ll find the winner.
把员工证……都收集起来……交给我……然后我们就知道是谁被选中了。

Its hand was barely grasping onto the strap of an employee ID card. “Alex” was the name written on it.
它的手中正艰难地握着一根员工证的挂绳，上面写着一个名字：“艾莉克斯”。

dataList.title:
Grade 8 Fixer
8阶收尾人
dataList.content:
... Alex.
……艾莉克斯。

Gone nuts, has she? And what’s that babble about winners?
她疯了吧？说什么选不选中的？

dataList.title:
Grade 8 Fixer
8阶收尾人
dataList.content:
Some Abnormalities... had to be placated with regular offerings as part of the managerial guidelines.
管理须知要求我们……定期向一些异想体提供牺牲者。

dataList.title:
A Survivor?
幸存者？
dataList.content:
You shouldn’t go that way... They will find you...
不能走那边……它们马上就会找到你……

dataList.title:
Grade 8 Fixer
8阶收尾人
dataList.content:
... You had to sacrifice people to it, didn't you?
……最终还是献祭了人类，对吧？

dataList.title:
A Survivor?
幸存者？
dataList.content:
It’s your turn... to draw...
该轮到你……抽签了……

<People...?>
<献祭人类……？>

What happens if no human sacrifice is made?
如果没有人被献祭，会发生什么？

dataList.title:
Grade 8 Fixer
8阶收尾人
dataList.content:
We never found out... We'd never deviated from the procedures.
我不知道……我们一直遵守着管理须知，从未有过任何偏差。

I guess it escaped and started killing people left and right.
我猜它会出逃，然后开始到处杀人。

Ha! That “Abnormality” must’ve been one spineless bugger. Does it thwack victims in the back of the head?
哈！那个叫异想体的玩意儿可真是够卑鄙的啊。它见到人后会重击受害人的后脑勺吗？

dataList.title:
Grade 8 Fixer
8阶收尾人
dataList.content:
What... do you mean?
这话……是什么意思？

Did you all get jabbed in the eyes or what? Those wounds were clearly left by humans. You can tell they were beating the shite out of each other.
你们的眼睛都是摆设吗？这些伤口显然是人类留下的，他们都拼命地想再给对方来一下。

Those thickos killed each other in a fight.
这群蠢货全都死在了自己人手上。

dataList.title:
Grade 8 Fixer
8阶收尾人
dataList.content:
B—but why would they do that?
为、为什么要这样？

S’clear as day.
很明显。

Probably figured they could last a bit even after the branch got buried.
他们大概是以为在支部下沉后，自己还剩些许机会能活下去吧。

Keep up the stream of human sacrifices nice and steady, and rescue might eventually arrive.
于是就继续定期献祭同伴，指望着哪天能获救。

Guess they kept the lots going for a few months, buyin' themselves time with each sacrifice.
我猜他们用这法子撑了几个月。毕竟只要多献上一个人，其他人就能多活上几天。

Problem, though: y’think the one who drew the short straw would always go quietly?
但是，你觉得被选中的人会乖乖接受吗？

If I were them, I’d rather bash the nearest bloke's head in than let 'em kill me.
如果我要死了，肯定会先打爆面前那家伙的脑袋。

Better them than me, ain’t that right?
那样，至少我现在不会被献祭掉，对吧？

... And the rest is history, I bet.
……哎，大概就是这么回事。

And the last survivor... put on the stone mask belonging to the statueheads...
然后最后存活的人……带上了和那东西一样的石像头套……

Believing that it’ll save her from being sacrificed.
认为这样自己就不用被献祭了。

dataList.title:
Grade 8 Fixer
8阶收尾人
dataList.content:
That can’t be. Alex isn't the kind of person who'd kill just so she could save her own skin—
不会是这样的。艾莉克斯绝对不是会为了自己活命而杀害他人的员工……

How do you know that? You can’t even be sure if that’s actually Alex or not.
你怎么知道呢？你都不确定这家伙是不是艾莉克斯。

dataList.title:
A Survivor?
幸存者？
dataList.content:
Let me... give you a tip...
让我……给你个建议吧……

dataList.title:
A Survivor?
幸存者？
dataList.content:
You’ll be much better off... going on your own foot... before they come for you... Kehehe... Kehe...
比起被强制带过去……你自己主动一点……可能会更好哦……咳……咳……

Let us be on our way. This person will perish before long.
我们走。此人活不了多久了。

While everyone else moved along, Yuri remained in place and kept on staring at the statue-clad individual.
当所有人都沿着道路前进时，只有尤莉停下了脚步，俯视着那个戴着石像头套的人。

dataList.title:
Grade 8 Fixer
8阶收尾人
dataList.content:
It wasn’t your fault... You know it’s not, right?
这不是你的错……你知道吧？

dataList.title:
A Survivor?
幸存者？
dataList.content:
Leave me behind, Yuri... Please leave me...
别管我了，尤莉……求求你别管我了……

<... Time to go.>
<……走吧。>
